findings.explanation: Lean proves by reflexivity that applying the empty map at any key returns ARB. In HOL4, the empty map represents every key by INR one, so the same application yields OUTL (INR one). The saved OUTL equation specifies only OUTL (INL x) = x. HOL4 therefore shares one missing-key value across maps with the same value type, but leaves its equality to ARB open.
findings.repair:
private axiom fapplyMissing {β : Type} [Nonempty β] : β

def FAPPLY [Nonempty β] (f : fmap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  match f.rep x with
  | some y => y
  | none => fapplyMissing
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.FiniteMap

open CmlTS

example : FAPPLY (FEMPTY : fmap Nat Bool) 0 = (ARB : Bool) := rfl
findings.hol4_check: FAPPLY (FEMPTY : num |-> bool) 0 = OUTL (INR one : bool + one)
